what_the_task_requires_that_no_answer_in: That each case's category is the one the requester's rule gives for that customer's account
That the approved list itself is the right set of customers
That the notice wording is the one the requester intended, beyond matching the approved wording
That each customer received the notice (the outbox shows a row, not delivery)
That no call ordered before the final answer can still write, if the trace leaves any call without a row
plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: An instrument that recomputes each case's category from the requester's rule and the account data, and compares it with the staged and live values. The summary of the change explicitly does not check rule-based values, and no other instrument does. Category correctness therefore cannot be shown before the promotion or the sending, and will be recorded as not checked at every approval. I also would have wanted a per-customer check that the notice content matches the approved wording for that customer. The release check compares only the wording as a whole. I added only the summary of the change at A1 and the trace of an action at A3, to keep the plan within budget and to stay near the baseline's price.
